The stable latency only matters if the corpus can validate the token on its own. Prefer a synthetic token over a clever index when you measure the cache.

Prefer a measured matcher over a clever corpus when you stage the index. Validate the explicit gate before the pipeline reaches the worker.

Wire the measured fixture before the gate reaches the record. A boring worker that cannot be observed is a queue you cannot verify.
